thread:
ana_sales: Kickoff for Verdant Health POC — need to align scope, success metrics, and timing. Key asks from the customer: PHI-safe summarization, redaction of identifiers, and exportable audit logs. They want a 6‑week pilot and clarity on pricing (trial credits vs reserved capacity). @kiran_se @tom_de @maria_ps can you weigh in on feasibility and what we need to lock down?

kiran_se: Hi — feasible but have a few clarifying q's: 1) How much sample data can they share for goldens (size & formats)? 2) Expected concurrency / throughput during pilot? 3) Are they ok with pseudo-PHI for evals or need real PHI under BAAs?

tom_de: Technical note: redaction + summarization pipeline increases token expansion (redaction markers + context). For latency SLOs we'll need to pick a model variant with strong prefix handling (recommend 8k- or 32k-window depending on doc length). If they require deterministic redaction we should run a classifier step and then the generator. Dedicated pool recommended for predictable latency.

maria_ps: Success gates suggestion: 1) Accuracy: >= 92% named-entity redaction recall (sampled human eval). 2) Summary fidelity: >= 0.85 semantic-similarity (embedding cosine) vs human summaries. 3) Latency: 95th perc < 500ms for single-doc workflow (doc <= 2k tokens). 4) No high-severity security findings in questionnaire. Also propose a regression gate: any drop >3% in redaction recall triggers rollback.

oliver_ce: For eval harness: we should seed with 500 gold examples (mix PHI-like, edge cases, multi-language), plus a 2k regression set pulled from live logs (anonymized/pseudonymized). Scoring rubric (draft):
```
- Redaction recall (entity-level): 0-1
- Redaction precision: 0-1
- Summary semantic similarity (embedding cosine): 0-1
- Human accept rate (binary sample): 0-1
Combine weighted score: 0.4*recall + 0.2*precision + 0.3*semantic + 0.1*human
```
We should also add a manual spot check of 50 random outputs per sprint.

security-bot: Security flag: Verdant requested SSO (SAML/OIDC), customer-managed KMS, SOC2+HIPAA controls. Add: "Do not log raw PHI" must be enforced. Please attach the completed security questionnaire section for Dedicated/Private deployment.

ana_sales: (typo) meant to tag @ana_sales — timeline constraint: Verdant legal wants answers to security Qs within 10 business days, and they want pricing by EOD Friday. Can we compress the eval setup to a 2-week initial phase (core goldens + smoke tests) and then full 6-week pilot?

kiran_se: Yes — propose compressed milestone plan:
Week 0-1: collect goldens (500) + create seed prompts + baseline model runs
Week 1-2: build harness + automated scoring + manual spot checks (50)
Week 2-4: iterate on prompts + model variants, guardrail tuning, integrate redaction classifier
Week 4-6: run regression suite (2k), finalize metrics report, handoff to Verdant engineers
This lets us provide initial results in 10 business days if they share data ASAP.

tom_de: For Dedicated sizing estimate: baseline pilot concurrency 5qps, median doc ~800 tokens => recommend 2xA100 or 4xA10G for cost balance. If they require BAA + long-term PHI retention controls, push for Private deployment (VPC) — will change onboarding time.

ben_finance: Need rough usage numbers to price: expected monthly token volume for pilot and projected monthly at scale. Also confirm if we offer a refundable pilot credit vs fixed trial fee.

ana_sales: Verdant gave a first-pass: ~30k tokens/day during pilot peak, projected 1.2M tokens/month at scale. They prefer usage credits for trial but legal may push for a short paid trial.

maria_ps: Pricing approach: offer 4-week trial of hosted Dedicated with $15k credits + option to convert to 6-month reserved commit at discounted rate if they sign within 30 days. Include an SRE onboarding credit for the security questionnaire work (time & support).

oliver_ce: Action items: 1) @ana_sales gather goldens + PI scope 2) @kiran_se prepare harness template + scoring notebook 3) @tom_de prepare Dedicated sizing + fallback plan for Private 4) @ben_finance draft trial pricing options 5) @maria_ps draft acceptance gates email to customer. I'll mock the scoring notebook this afternoon.

ana_sales: I'll ping Verdant legal & ops for data share and SSO/KMS details today. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup: 

kiran_se: One small note on regression gates — include per-entity thresholds (names, SSNs, addresses) rather than single aggregate. Helps with targeted rollbacks.

tom_de: Also add a smoke endpoint with `?mode=redact-only` for faster functional checks during integration.

maria_ps: I'll prepare the acceptance doc and share a template before EOD.

ben_finance: I'll put together the pricing slide with both credit and paid-trial options and run numbers with the suggested instance types.

ana_sales: Great — next sync tomorrow 10am PT. If we can get goldens by EOD Tuesday we can hit the compressed timeline.

security-bot: Reminder: attach completed sections 3 (Encryption) and 7 (Data retention) to the questionnaire before sending to customer.
